## Insure the Class

<!-- The QR code is switched by `show.dice-qr` in _quarto.yml. -->

:::: {.columns .rules-layout}
::: {.column .rules-text}
You run a phone insurance company. A claim costs **$600**.

::: {.incremental}
- Every customer is the same: roll a die, and **a 1 means a claim** (a 1 in 6 chance).
- Each team secretly sets a **premium**. Customers go to the cheapest insurer.
- Roll for each customer, then tally your profit and loss.
:::
:::

:::
